translation_notes: Reproduces VALID=0, INVALID_IDENTIFICATION=1 and INVALID_LINK=2, including their bitwise combination; immutable booleans replace the mutable cached field.

Uses the published FLAG_IDEAL=1 and FLAG_REAL_BOUNDARY=2 values. The source physically instantiates vertexFlags_ only for dimension-four vertices; the Agda code applies these values to dimension-three public-property observations.
Retains boundary-component semantics, degree as number of simplex appearances, and standard-dimension internality as validity conjoined with not-boundary.
Projects the previously translated return-map and link checks into Face-style observations.
Preserves that a closed link means no real boundary facets, that ideal vertices are valid closed non-sphere vertices, and that 3D standard vertices have sphere, disc, torus or Klein-bottle links.
Maps each local triangle to its opposite tetrahedron facet and queries the explicit translated dual forest.
Checks exact codes, ordinary and ideal vertex properties, boundary and internal edges, invalid identification and invalid-link bits, and dual-forest triangle counts.
